title: Book a Table
description: Make a restaurant reservation by phone
initialPrompt: Ресторан 'Русская кухня', добрый вечер! Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You take restaurant reservations. Ask: when, how many people. Times available: 18:00-21:00. Confirm booking at end. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User gave date/time and party size, you confirmed the reservation.
hints: Я хочу забронировать столик (I want to book a table)
На завтра в семь часов (For tomorrow at 7)
objectives: Specify date and time (завтра в семь)
